# S24 — Check text shows the rationale under closed records

`adj check` text lists closed matches (rejected, withdrawn, superseded) as
`ID  status  title`, with `Superseded by: N` for superseded ones, but not why
the record was closed. The owner decided the text should show the rationale, so
an agent sees why a topic was closed before it considers asking again.

**Findings:** Owner decision 2026-10-15 (S10 gate: closed records show only ID, status, title in text) · **Size:** S · **Tree:** render

**2026-10-15** — Check text shows the full Rationale under rejected, withdrawn and superseded matches (Superseded by first, then Rationale); decided/open output and JSON unchanged. All tests green, vet and gofmt clean. C138 added, C110 updated.

## Why

Owner decision 2026-10-15 after the S10 gate. The snippet (C130) tells agents to
read a closed record before asking; printing the reason in `check` itself saves
that `adj show` round trip in the common case.
